value.rationale: The exact observable used by Sanders et al. is calibrated with empirical C=0.6. This expansion supplies a mathematically controlled barrier-dependent replacement for the empirical calibration and resolves the first offset-dependent distortion for detectors near both saddles, giving an explicit systematic shift instead of a single multiplicative factor. The near-barrier window is natural to tipping detection; the positive coefficient records the bias of finite barriers. It is a genuinely source-motivated next-order quantitative feature rather than a restatement of the known Gaussian crossover.
